transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.

transcript.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
transcript.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Second flight on your six! Turn!

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: TEAL (tape): He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: His wingmen first. Then him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: RUSK: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: MARINE: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.

transcript.speaker: HARBOR
transcript.text: HARBOR: Loyalist pilots answering. Every harbor.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: RUSK: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: RUSK: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.

transcript.speaker: RUSK
transcript.text: RUSK: Then hear it from me. Head on.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 3 inbound.
